mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, shop_lat, shop_lng, delivery_radius_km, delivery_min_amount, delivery_fee_type, order_time_enabled, order_start_time, order_end_time, qywx_webhook_url_enc, has_qywx_webhook, payment_qr_url, ad_enabled, ad_image_url, ad_link_type, ad_link_target, updated_by, create_time, update_time FROM shop_config WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_config (shop_id, shop_lat, shop_lng, delivery_radius_km, delivery_min_amount, delivery_fee_type, order_time_enabled, order_start_time, order_end_time, qywx_webhook_url_enc, has_qywx_webhook, payment_qr_url, ad_enabled, ad_image_url, ad_link_type, ad_link_target, updated_by) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{shopLat}, #{shopLng}, #{deliveryRadiusKm}, #{deliveryMinAmount}, #{deliveryFeeType}, #{orderTimeEnabled}, #{orderStartTime}, #{orderEndTime}, #{qywxWebhookUrlEnc}, #{hasQywxWebhook}, #{paymentQrUrl}, #{adEnabled}, #{adImageUrl}, #{adLinkType}, #{adLinkTarget}, #{updatedBy})
